title: Fix pre-merge review findings
summary: The launcher checks WANDB_API_KEY only before a launch, so cleanup of a crashed online allocation works without it. Offline W&B runs copy checkpoints so a host sync uploads them. Status links open the rendered results section, and the site fallbacks point to the registry on GitHub. Retired tripod directories gain tree pins, and the restore guide fetches the PR commit into a local ref before its checks.
next: After the squash merge, delete the head branch so new clones skip the retired files; refs/pull/33/head keeps the archive pins resolvable.
reason: Launch guards, run tracking and documentation links change no measured result, roadmap marker or gate.
